text:
Carter Hart is in his second season in Vegas and has made 13 starts. He is 7-4-2 with an .886 save percentage: around average, not stealing games.

Our numbers have him allowing 37 goals on 35.9 expected (what his shots against usually produce), 1.1 worse than average. The split by shot type is the story. He's excellent on easy shots (.979 on low danger, league .962) but at .619 on high-danger ones against a league .684, and 13.6% of his saves lead to another shot within three seconds (league 10.7%). Rebounds and the hard chances are where goals get through.

Vancouver scored five on him on Nov. 15, and in Winnipeg on Nov. 21 The Athletic's Jesse Granger noted that for the second start in a row, the first shot of the game went in. Granger also credited "a couple of huge saves" on the penalty kill that night in a Vegas win. Last season he was 4.4 goals below expected in 18 games by our count, though Evolving-Hockey, on its own scale, had him above average. Watch the rebound rate.
